title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
Registration on a Part-time Basis
Registration procedures and forms for part-time
students
are the same as those for full-time students as given in the previous sections. Part-time students are defined as registering for 1.75 credits or less per
term
.
To request a change from part-time to full-time status, a student may complete the full-time request form.
